origine_fr: Un toit 宀 sur 祭, écrit 月, 卩 et 示. Regarder de près ce qui se passe sous le toit : examiner, observer. 祭 donnait le son, mais il se lit jì, loin de chá.
origine_en: A roof 宀 over 祭, written 月, 卩 and 示. Looking closely at what goes on under the roof: to examine, to observe. 祭 once gave the sound, but it is read jì, far from chá.

phrase.pinyin: Tā zài guānchá tiān shàng de xīngxing.
phrase.fr: Il observe les étoiles dans le ciel.
phrase.en: He is watching the stars in the sky.
